Use case: stylized-concept.

Create one premium realistic painterly raster character concept for the manifest-bound target "affinity-workflow-v1-grey-wolf-fire-v2".

Subject and threat:
- Species: grey-wolf.
- Threat presentation tier: elite; reference Grade 4; canonical Grade not assigned.
- Battlefield duty: flanking-predator.
- Construction mode: organic-quadruped.

Identity invariants:
- recognizable wolf face
- fast flanking silhouette
- natural predatory posture

Anatomy invariants:
- canine anatomy
- exactly four legs
- credible ground contact

Affinity: fire.
Affinity expression: heat-blackened surfaces, internal ember seams, controlled combustion, smoke, and heat distortion
Counterplay cue: The internal core or heat sink becomes exposed between combustion cycles.
Altered dimensions: material; motion; attack-telegraph; environmental-wake.
Permitted transformations: material; motion; attack telegraph; environmental wake.
Prohibited traits: humanoid armor; antlers; wings; dragon anatomy; a uniform orange full-body glow that destroys material and anatomy detail; uncanonical prompt or incomplete reference provenance.

Presentation:
- Style: Pack 2 premium realistic painterly medieval dark fantasy with coherent materials, controlled linework, grounded anatomy, and restrained local magical emission.
- Medium: premium realistic painterly raster character concept.
- Background: neutral cracked-stone floor against a charcoal-to-midnight backdrop.
- Lighting: controlled neutral key with restrained local affinity emission and readable materials.
- Composition: Exactly one full-body Fire Grey Wolf in the approved flanking stance; nose, tail, paws, flame tips, smoke, and heat distortion remain centered inside the inner eighty-four percent of the fully finished canvas.
- Canvas: 1536 x 1024 image/png with at least 8 percent safe margin around the entire silhouette and all extremities.
- Framing lock: fit every hard extent—including weapon tip, standard, horns, tail, and effect wake—inside the central 84 percent of both canvas dimensions; leave a clearly empty border on all four sides.

Reference routing, in supplied order:
1. assets/enemies/experiments/affinity-workflow-v1/candidates/grey-wolf/fire-v1.png — Previous Fire Grey Wolf candidate supplies the retained wolf identity, fire integration, stance, and finish; reproduce that design through canonical manifest-bound prompt provenance rather than copying unrelated traits.
2. assets/enemies/review/beasts-v1.webp — First subject only: established Grey Wolf anatomy, coat, ground contact, and flanking silhouette; do not transfer the Dire Wolf, Cave Bear, or Tunnel Boar.

Constraints:
- No labels, text, UI, frame, logo, or watermark.
- No extra creature, cropped extremity, blank band, unfinished region, or abrupt canvas cutoff.
- No resemblance to a published character or reference person.
